requirements.requirement: The system must define a Pydantic model for clinical trial proximity that includes distance_miles as a float field.
The system must define a Pydantic model for clinical trial proximity that includes duration_minutes as a float field.
The system must define a normalized_score field constrained between 0 and 100 inclusive.
The system must include a metadata object containing route_source as a string field.
The system must include a metadata object containing timestamp as a valid datetime field.
The system must enforce type validation using Pydantic such that invalid field types raise validation errors.
The system must ensure the proximity schema is serializable to JSON without custom encoders.
The system must ensure compatibility with existing clinical trial models by allowing embedding or extension without breaking existing fields.
The system must accept distance_miles values greater than or equal to 0.
The system must accept duration_minutes values greater than or equal to 0.
The system must reject normalized_score values outside the 0 to 100 range.
The system must raise a validation error if required fields (distance_miles, duration_minutes, normalized_score) are missing.
The system must allow metadata fields to be optional while still validating correctly when provided.
The system must default timestamp to the current UTC time if not explicitly provided.
The system must raise a validation error when distance_miles or duration_minutes are negative values.
The system must support instantiation of the proximity model from existing clinical_trials_service outputs without transformation errors.
